 next page Post published at 16:13 GMT 16:13 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Chris Sutton 
Former Blackburn striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 A good counter-attack from Manchester City. 
 Iliman Ndiaye drives from the halfway line, but the angle looked tight for the shot. 
 Bart Verbruggen dives to his left-hand-side, and he tips it onto the post. What a save.
 Image source, Getty Images

 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Just before that Gianluigi Donnarumma save Bart Verbruggen had made an even better one at the other end to deny Iliman Ndiaye.

 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 A wild back pass from Tarik Muharemovic. James Trafford tries his best to prevent the corner but there's nothing he can do there.

 'Defending has gone wrong' published at 16:12 GMT 16:12 GMT 
 Coventry City 3-0 Sunderland 
 Ellen White 
Former England striker on Final Score 
 Defending for Sunderland has gone wrong today. Making a lot of unforced errors. 
 Coventry have been brilliant. Jack Rudoni there with the goal from outside the box, they've come out of the blocks again.

 YELLOW CARD published at 16:12 GMT 16:12 GMT 
 Hull City 0-1 Ipswich Town 
 Abdoul Ouattara is far too fast for Elliot Stroud, who has to resort to grabbing the Ipswich player's arm and is the first Hull player to be cautioned.

 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 A looping ball into the box that hands for Maxim de Cuyper to attack and it requires a diving save from Gianluigi Donnarumma at his near post.

 Post published at 16:11 GMT 16:11 GMT 
 Brentford 1-0 Nottm Forest 
 Ryan Yates has to do better there. He times the run brilliantly, racing across Michael Kayode and into the six yard box, but he heads miles over.

 Post published at 16:09 GMT 16:09 GMT 
 Hull City 0-1 Ipswich Town 
 Ipswich left winger Jaden Philogene catches Hull skipper Lewie Coyle late on the ankle, but just a free-kick and no card shown.
 55 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:09 GMT 16:09 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 There's been a bit of talk about where Dominic Calvert-Lewin's future will be with Manchester United reportedly sniffing around. 
 Talk of a new contract at Leeds soon ramped up after that. 
 132 26 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Coventry 3-0 Sunderland published at 16:09 GMT 16:09 GMT 
 Jack Rudoni (52 mins) 
 Coventry are enjoying themselves here but again it's sloppy defending from Sunderland.
 Jack Rudoni is teed up and allowed to get a shot away. It takes a deflection off Omar Alderete and that completely wrongfoots goalkeeper Robin Roefs and it nestles into the bottom corner.
 A terrible day at the office for Sunderland.
 Image source, Getty Images

 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Maxim de Cuyper goes into the referee's book for a late challenge on Enzo Fernandez.

 Post published at 16:08 GMT 16:08 GMT 
 Hull City 0-1 Ipswich Town 
 Tim Iroegbunam with a charge through the middle of the field for Hull and he gets to the edge of the penalty area, but Julio Enciso had tracked the run all the way and is helped out by Exequiel Palacios as the pair eventually crowd the Hull man out.

 Post published at 16:07 GMT 16:07 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Three points here for Bournemouth would be massive.
 Marco Rose would love to build on that stunning 3-0 win at Old Trafford last weekend. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 109 124 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Golden opportunity' published at 16:07 GMT 16:07 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Chris Sutton 
Former Blackburn striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 That is a golden opportunity. Fabian Hurzeler knows it. The ball just sat up for Maxim De Cuyper. A big chance, and he took it first time, but he couldn't get the connection right. 
 74 47 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:06 GMT 16:06 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Massive chance for Brighton to double their lead early in the second half.
 Yasin Ayari times his run brilliantly and puts the ball on a plate for Maxim de Cuyper, who blasts his effort over the bar.
 A massive chance early on.
 96 91 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 16:05 GMT 16:05 GMT 
 Hull City 0-1 Ipswich Town 
 Hull needed to do something at the break and Sergej Jakirovic makes one change with defender John Egan replaced by midfielder Matt Crooks.
 35 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:05 GMT 16:05 GMT 
 Coventry 2-0 Sunderland 
 Sunderland have lost each of their last 48 Premier League games when trailing by 2+ goals at half time since a 2-2 draw with West Bromwich Albion in December 2002.
 66 26 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:04 GMT 16:04 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Bournemouth have lost just three of their previous 52 Premier League home games when leading at half-time (W38 D11) and are unbeaten in their last 19 (W14 D5) since a 2-1 loss against Wolves in October 2023.
 65 63 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:04 GMT 16:04 GMT 
 Coventry 2-0 Sunderland 
 Sunderland have got a big hill to climb in this second half.
 Many thought they could be heading for the drop this season with the added burden of European football.
 Is that theory coming to fruition?
 128 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 16:03 GMT 16:03 GMT 
 Brentford 1-0 Nottm Forest 
 Oliver Glasner has made a double change during the break.
 Ryan Yates takes the captain's armband off Morgan Gibbs-White and makes his first appearance of the season, replacing Xaver Schlager.
 Daniel Munoz comes on for Ola Aina.
